text:SpecialActionText_JP:SPECIALACTION_:
[Just for an instant, about one punch's worth]
If attacked while time is stopped, you can
counterattack once.
If it hits, the time stop is canceled.
9f9dc28e

Attacks using "Emerald Splash" deal more damage,
and attacks using "Tentacles" deal less damage.

[Mastery]
When HP falls below a certain level, or when hit by a skill for a set time
after using the skill "I've learned that one too", "Mastery" rises.
Higher Mastery raises the speed of all actions.
At a certain level of Mastery, specific attacks are enhanced.
7aff5b0b

Your own Stand that appears during normal attacks etc.
cannot be hit by attacks from other Statues.

[Energy of Resentment]
Depending on remaining HP, the summoned dolls gain faster
cooldown recovery, skill speed, movement speed and ATK.
ba02df38

[Mastery] When HP falls below a certain level,
or when the Mind SP Skill "You're a master... a master swordsman"
is used, "Mastery" rises.
Higher Mastery raises the speed of all actions.
At a certain level of Mastery, specific attacks are enhanced.

[Settling In]
The 5th normal attack is a blood-sucking attack that restores a little HP.
The "Settling In" level rises bit by bit depending on whose blood is drunk,
and at a certain amount an effect triggers: longer time stop,
shorter CT, ATK up and DEF down, each changing in up to 4 stages.
adb7e2ef

[Settling In] The 5th normal attack is a blood-sucking attack that
restores a little HP and raises the "Settling In" level by 2.
The level rises bit by bit depending on the target attacked, and at a certain
amount an effect triggers: longer time stop, shorter CT,
ATK up and DEF down, each changing in up to 4 stages.

[I've already put the "safety catch" on you...]
Has a chance to activate on normal attacks.
When active, for a set time, each hit you take
inflicts an ATK-down status on the attacker.

[Bomb #3] Turns back time, restoring your stats to their state
at the start of the area, except for Finisher SP Skill uses.
Team members and enemies keep the stats they had
before "Bomb #3" was activated.
Activating it uses up a Finisher SP Skill use.

[Bomb #3] Turns back time, restoring your stats to their state
at the start of the area, except for Finisher SP Skill uses.
Team members and enemies keep the stats they had
before "Bomb #3" was activated.

2b00bbe9

[Fear]
Landing attacks draws out signs of fear from the opponent.
The attacks that raise Fear change with each battle.
While a sign is showing, some SP Skills are enhanced.

text:optionText_JP:pass_caution_01:
Issue a password for data transfer.
Keep your password safe,
and do not share or publish it.

*When transferring to a different OS,
[Diamond Coins] cannot be carried over.
*Passwords are valid for 3 months.
If you issue a new password after setting one,
the old password becomes invalid.
Please be careful.
*If you transfer in the middle of a battle,
you cannot return to that battle after the transfer.
